adjudications.reason: The frozen excerpts identify Table 2 and mention only some datasets; the per-dataset MAE_C cells needed to establish or refute every-dataset reduction are absent.
The frozen excerpts do not provide an exhaustive TDBA dataset list or an explicit exclusion of ETTm1.

decision: Use adjudicated labels only for opened-development analysis; preserve original Round 2 labels and require independent annotation for promotion data.
